title: 毎日王冠の後に・でけえ背中

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hgraaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap takes first place! Oguri Cap emerges victorious in this nail-biting race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: What a race! This Mainichi Okan is gonna go down in history, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: And this is partly thanks to Inari One! You truly are what we need, in this age where Oguri Cap and the others shine so brightly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Inari's unbelievable! To think she'd be able to do so well against the best runners in her generation!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ergh… Dammit, dammit, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I lost! She wiped the floor with me!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I wasn't supposed to lose here!)

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: You're the best, Oguri! What a race!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: I'll be cheering for you at the autumn Tenno Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (She's so imposing. The shadow she casts is huge.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The way I am now… there's no way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leaving the racecourse with Inari One, I can't help but notice the hard look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rack my brain, trying to come up with the right words to say…

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Inari One sure was incredible! I didn't think she had it in her to go head-to-head with Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: I guess they're kinda similar. They both got too good for regional races and had to come out here. They grew too big for their little ponds.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: But… it's also pretty hard to get noticed in the regionals. They must be putting in a lot of extra work to grab people's attention.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Exactly. Seeing Inari One today convinced me it would've been a waste for her to stay in the regionals. That's why she's in the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ya got it all wrong! That's not why I'm here…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling it'd be best to get Inari away from everyone as quickly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right, sorry. Let's get goin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One applies herself passionately to training for the autumn Tenno Sho, but I keep catching glimpses of a pained expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whazza matter, Boss? You all right? Could scare the clouds away with that face you're makin'!
choice_data_list: I should be asking if you're all right.
I should be asking if you're all right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whazza matter, Boss? You all right? Could scare the clouds away with that face you're makin'!
choice_data_list: I should be asking if you're all right.
I should be asking if you're all right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: 'Course I am! No need to worry 'bout me! Sure, I've been a bit down 'cause the weather's been all gloomy lately, but that's all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I realized somethin'. I'm nowhere good enough to win the autumn Tenno Sho right now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Durin' the Mainichi Okan, I saw just how much stronger Oguri is than me, and I'm determined to close that gap, even if it kills me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, Creek'll be there too, and she's just as good as Oguri. That means I gotta put the pedal to the metal 'n' train like hell!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's keep it up, partner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like she says, there's no way she'll be Umamusume of the Year if she can't beat Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean she should run herself into the ground. There's no way I'll let that happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seems like I'll have to keep a close eye on her. I might have to intervene if it comes down to it, to ensure her own safety.
choice_data_list: (Even if it isn't what she wants…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer and faithful partner in all this, I have to be ready.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (This is bad. Even Boss's worryin' about me now. I'm a real joke…)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (This is bad. Even Boss's worryin' about me now. I'm a real joke…)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Guess that's no surprise. My fault I lost, and the only way I'm gonna make up for that is by winnin'.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I gotta win…)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (The others must be dead focused on trainin'. They're probably workin' way harder than me, workin' at levels leagues above my own!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (But me…)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (My runnin's nowhere near good enough to really show off how incredible the people of Oi are.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (If I can't become Umamusume of the Year, my performance on the track 'n' the claims I made'll be for nothing!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (The stakes're so high, but there's no way I can beat Oguri and Creek right now.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, I won't be able to answer everyone's hopes…)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I know I gotta eat, but my appetite's busted.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho looms in the distance, and it won't be long at all until it's upon us.
